title: What do Planning’s stage records actually measure?
question: Which Planning stages carry a scored deadline and which have no issued score or end date?
finding: The November 17 extract contains 67,798 published stage observations. It flags 336 for potential data error. Rows without an outcome are shown separately.
how: Use the later November 17 snapshot once, preserving issuer observations. Exclude flagged records from outcome counts and durations. Multiple observations may refer to a single record. The median uses completed, nonnegative, unflagged stage values.
limits: The earlier snapshot overlaps this one. Neither a missing outcome nor a missing end date establishes a missed deadline. A planning entitlement, a building permit, and a station visit each have different triggers.
